answers.explanation: It only reports. Fixing the problem is up to the source host.
The source address is the one thing every IP packet carries, so that's who hears about the problem.
8 is the request, 0 is the reply.
Type 11. Traceroute sends packets with TTL 1, 2, 3... and collects these messages to map the route.
Type 3 has several codes saying exactly what couldn't be reached.
1 is ICMP, 6 is TCP, 17 is UDP.
Everything up to the gateway is fine. Climb the ladder: the first failure marks the spot.
Many hosts and firewalls block ICMP on purpose. No reply is only a clue.
